label: reference-quality
reason: Internal trigger was clearly unique relative to local candles and is a strong reference example.

label: weak-trigger
reason: Trigger was roughly the same size/character as the previous 3–4 candles, so it lacked meaningful local uniqueness.

label: structural-dominance-exception
reason: PPA was good/decent. Even though nearby candles were large, the trigger engulfed/dominated the entire relevant previous break. Structural dominance compensated for weaker visual uniqueness.

label: forecast-invalidated
reason: Internal short was watched/armed, but no convincing bearish engulf or momentum shift developed.

label: good-skip-big-winner
reason: A skipped B&R later moved strongly. Outcome does not retroactively make the skip bad.
